Tests must write only under $WORK and invoke linekit through the run helper; the requested suite should cover A1–A14 without changing existing test files.
steps: Implement usage_wrap and cmd_wrap in lib/cmd_wrap.sh. Parse -w with getopts, validate WIDTH against the positive decimal format with no leading zero, and use the shared error and file-check helpers.
